notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (tier a) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entries and no blanket 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /', so no tier is blocked by policy; it does list the sitemap index. Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) worked for robots.txt and the GB-locale XML sitemap (8/info/sitemaps/sitemap-home-categories-zh-gb-0.xml.gz, 338 URLs) - Akamai does not challenge these static assets - but every HTML page (home, category) returned an Akamai Bot Manager interstitial JS-challenge shell (bm-verify meta-refresh), unusable for parsing. Tier (b) Playwright headless=True got a hard 'Access Denied' (Akamai fingerprints headless Chromium). Escalated within tier (b) to headless=False (headed) Chromium with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, which passed the Akamai challenge cleanly and loaded the real Angular site; reused across all subsequent page loads in the same tier. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed (and was confirmed disconnected beforehand). This mirrors the sister site Zara Home UAE (SR21) exactly. TREE: built the union of (1) the top mega-menu flyout for every department (Bedroom, Home Decor, Kitchen and Dining, Bathroom, Kids and Baby, Furniture, Laundry Care), (2) each visited category page's own on-page tab-strip sub-navigation, and (3) the GB-locale XML sitemap cross-checked by keyword (bed/cushion/throw/blanket/towel/curtain/napkin/rug/organis/storage/basket/box/etc) to catch nodes not reachable from the nav. Sitemap URLs suffixed '-all-' were confirmed (by visiting) to be either the group's own View-All aggregator (dropped per the Parent Category URL Rule since true sibling subcategory pages exist, e.g. bedroom-fillings-all-n1384, dining-table-linen-tablecloths-n1034 traffic already covered by Napkins/Placemats/Table Runners, home-decor-rugs-living-room-n992 covered by its Vintage/Jute/Doormats/Runner/Kitchen children) or genuinely dead (redirect to /gb/error.html: bed-linen-all-n4129, bedroom-basic-sheets-all-n5514, bedroom-fillings-n954, livingroom-rugs-all-n4121, kids-bedroom-decoration-n1119, dining-furniture-storage-n4742). winter-duvet-n4965 loaded normally (title 'Winter duvets') but rendered 0 product cards and duplicates the already-captured Duvets leaf, so it was omitted rather than recorded as a fabricated/duplicate row. QTY: Zara Home shows no explicit 'N products' counter; the GB store lazy-loads inside an Angular Material sidenav container (not the window), so qty = the count of article.product-item cards after programmatically scrolling that inner container to bottom repeatedly until the raw card count was stable across 3+ consecutive checks. A second-order defect was found and corrected during this run: on any page with its own material/type filter-tab strip (e.g. Basics' COTTON PERCALE/SATEEN COTTON/LINEN tabs, or Kids Bedding's BED LINEN/COT BEDDING/BEDSPREADS AND QUILTS/CUSHIONS AND THROWS tabs), those tab chips render as sibling <article> elements identical in tag to real product cards, inflating the raw count by the tab count (verified directly on bedroom-basic-sheets-percale-n5336 and doormats-n4979, where 6 of 8 raw <article> elements were tab chips, not products). Final qty on every leaf below = raw article count filtered to only cards containing an actual quick-add 'ADD' button + price, which reliably excludes the tab chips (confirmed no false negatives: a product genuinely out of stock/without a live price was not observed in any sampled page). All qtys were reconfirmed via a second full pass after this fix. EXCLUDED and why: home-decor-baskets-n997 and home-decor-jewellery-boxes-n971 (breadcrumbed under HOME DECOR, decorative-basket/jewellery-box boundary per storage.md Sec5/Sec24 - Decorative Home Accessories, out of this task's scope); furniture-storage-n4111 and dining-furniture-storage-n4742 (Furniture nav group / dead link respectively - Furniture.xlsx's domain, already validated, not re-verified here); bathroom-bins-n3827 (waste/trash bins, not storage/organization containers), bathroom-soap-dispensers-n3882, bathroom-toothbrush-tumblers-n3883, bathroom-soap-dishes-n3884, bathroom-trays-n3885 (hygiene/decorative accessories, not storage per storage.md Sec24/Sec26); laundry-care-n1399 (title 'Products for clothing care and laundry care' - mixed ironing/detergent/clothes-care equipment, predominantly non-storage per storage.md Sec11/Sec30, no dedicated storage-only sub-listing); laundry-cleaning-n2485 (cleaning supplies, not storage); bathroom-baskets-all-n4142 (title 'Bathroom Baskets', qty 43 - a narrower see-all than the sum of the already-captured Cosmetic Storage (56) + Laundry Baskets (18) children, i.e. the group's own aggregator tab, dropped per the Parent Category URL Rule); dressing-room-n2463 (its own 'Storage' tab is a same-URL celement filter pointing back to bathroom-baskets-all-n4142, already excluded as a duplicate aggregator; the page itself is otherwise a Hangers+Furniture+Storage cross-link aggregate, not a distinct category); kids-hangers-n1131 (hangers, not covered by storage.md); bathroom-toiletry-wash-bags-n4748 (personal toiletry/wash bag - carrying bag, not home textile/storage per storage.md Sec6 boundary); kids-furniture-n1122 (its 'Storage'/'Desks and chairs' nav labels are celement filters on the Kids Furniture page - Furniture.xlsx's domain); picnic-collection-n1812 (mixed general-merchandise themed Collection - plates/cutlery/blankets/baskets combined under one qty, not a clean single-type category, and a Collection per the View-All/Collections exclusion rule). Also excluded as not applicable to either ruleset: Vases, Photo Frames, Decorative Candles, Candle Holders, Door Knobs and Hooks (Decorative Home Accessories); Mirrors, Lamps and Lighting (Lighting/other tasks); Kitchen & Dining tableware/glassware/cutlery/cookware/serving trays (Kitchen and Dining task, not Storage per storage.md Sec13/Sec26 unless explicitly a storage/organization product, which these are not); all Furniture-nav items (sofas, chairs, tables, wardrobes, bed frames, headboards, sideboards, cabinets, shelving units - Furniture.xlsx's already-validated domain); Clothing and Footwear, Toys, Fragrances (out of scope for both rulesets). LOW-confidence rows (review queue): Bathrobes and Slippers (bathroom-bathrobes-n1053, Textile) - mixes textile bathrobes with footwear slippers under one qty; and Storage (baby-organisers-n4758, Storage) - title 'Baby bumpers and organizers' may mix cot bumpers (non-storage) with organizers (storage), no way to isolate a storage-only count. MEDIUM-confidence rows: Duvets, Pillows, Cushion Inserts, Protectors (Textile) and Towel Racks and Hooks (Storage) - see per-row flags.
